text: By far, I would say the speed and ambition of working at OpenAI are just dramatically more than what I can imagine.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Lenny asks Alexander what is most different about how OpenAI operates compared to other places he's worked. Alexander explains that despite having been a startup founder who thought his company moved fast, OpenAI's speed and ambition are on a completely different level that forced him to reimagine what those concepts even mean.
text_ko: 솔직히 말하면, OpenAI에서 일하는 속도와 야망은 제가 상상했던 것보다 훨씬 더 압도적이에요.
text_zh: 不得不说，在OpenAI工作的节奏和野心程度，真的是超出了我的想象。
text_es: Con diferencia, diría que el ritmo y la ambición de trabajar en OpenAI son muchísimo más de lo que me podía imaginar.
key_sentence: Working at OpenAI reimagines speed and ambition beyond what I can imagine.
original_text: By far, I would say the speed and ambition of working at OpenAI are just dramatically more than what I can imagine. And I guess it's kind of an embarrassing thing to say because everyone who's a startup founder thinks like, "Oh yeah, my startup moves super fast and the talent bar is super high and we're super ambitious." But I have to say, working in OpenAI just made me reimagine what that even means.

vocabulary.definition: A strong desire to achieve success or a particular goal, often requiring determination and hard work.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business, ambition is crucial for driving innovation and growth, as it motivates individuals and teams to pursue challenging objectives and push boundaries.
vocabulary.nuance: While ambition is generally viewed positively, it can sometimes imply a relentless pursuit that may overlook ethical considerations or teamwork.

vocabulary.definition: In a striking or impressive manner; significantly or substantially.
vocabulary.businessContext: In the context of business and technology, 'dramatically' often describes substantial changes or improvements in performance, market conditions, or operational efficiency.
vocabulary.nuance: This term conveys a sense of urgency or importance, and is best used when the change is both noticeable and impactful.

text: One of the learnings over the past year is that for models to do stuff, they're much more effective when they can use a computer. It turns out the best way for models to use computers is simply to write code.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Lenny asks Alexander how he thinks OpenAI will win in the AI coding space. Alexander explains his vision for building a super assistant that can take actions in the world. He argues that the most effective way for AI models to use computers and accomplish tasks is through writing code, leading to the insight that all useful agents should fundamentally be coding agents.
text_ko: 지난 1년 동안 얻은 교훈 중 하나는 모델(models)이 뭔가를 하려면 컴퓨터를 사용할 수 있을 때 훨씬 더 효과적이라는 점이에요. 그리고 모델들이 컴퓨터를 활용하는 가장 좋은 방법은 그냥 코드를(code) 쓰는 것이더라고요.
text_zh: 过去一年我们发现，要让模型真正干活儿，最有效的方式就是让它们能操作电脑。而模型操作电脑最好的办法，说白了就是写代码。
text_es: Una de las cosas que hemos aprendido este último año es que para que los modelos hagan cosas de verdad, son mucho más efectivos cuando pueden usar una computadora. Y resulta que la mejor manera de que los modelos usen computadoras es simplemente escribiendo código.
key_sentence: Turns out, models are more effective when they can write code.
original_text: One of the learnings over the past year is that for models to do stuff, they're much more effective when they can use a computer. It turns out the best way for models to use computers is simply to write code. And so we're kind of getting to this idea where if you want to build any agent, maybe you should be building a coding agent.

vocabulary.definition: Producing a desired or intended result; successful in achieving a goal.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and technology, 'effective' often describes strategies, tools, or processes that yield measurable outcomes, such as increased productivity or improved customer satisfaction.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'effective' implies success, it does not necessarily indicate efficiency; something can be effective but resource-intensive.

vocabulary.definition: Representations or simulations of a system, process, or concept used for analysis and decision-making.
vocabulary.businessContext: In tech and startups, 'models' can refer to data models, business models, or predictive models that help organizations understand trends and make informed decisions.
vocabulary.nuance: The term 'models' can imply theoretical frameworks or practical applications, depending on the context in which it is used.

text: A few of us are constantly on Reddit. There's praise up there and there's a lot of complaints.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Lenny asks Alexander how they measure progress on Codex and what metrics they focus on. Alexander explains that beyond traditional metrics, his team actively monitors social media platforms like Reddit to gather user feedback. He emphasizes their philosophy of building tools that maximize human acceleration rather than creating confusion about the human's role.
text_ko: 우리 중 몇몇은 항상 레딧(Reddit)을 보고 있어요. 거기엔 칭찬도 있고 불만도 많이 있어요.
text_zh: 我们几个人天天刷Reddit，上面有夸我们的，但抱怨也是一大堆。
text_es: Varios de nosotros estamos todo el tiempo en Reddit. Ahí hay elogios y también un montón de quejas.
key_sentence: There's praise up there and there's a lot of complaints.
original_text: A few of us are constantly on Reddit. There's praise up there and there's a lot of complaints. What we can do is as a product team just try to always think about how are we building a tool so that it feels like we're maximally accelerating people rather than building a tool that makes it more unclear what you should do as the human?

text: One of the most mind-blowing examples of acceleration, the Sora Android app, like a fully new app, we built it in 18 days and then 10 days later, so 28 days total, we went to the public.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Alexander is describing the impressive capabilities of Codex in accelerating software development at OpenAI. He shares a concrete example of how Codex enabled the team to build and ship the Sora Android app - which became the number one app in the app store - in just 28 days total, demonstrating the dramatic speed improvements possible with AI coding assistance.
text_ko: 가장 놀라운 가속화의 예 중 하나인 Sora 안드로이드 앱은 완전히 새로운 앱처럼, 우리는 18일 만에 만들었고, 그 후 10일이 지나서 총 28일 만에 공개했어요.
text_zh: Sora Android 应用是加速的一个令人震惊的例子，我们在18天内完成了这个全新的应用，10天后，也就是总共28天，我们就向公众发布了。
text_es: Uno de los ejemplos más sorprendentes de aceleración, la aplicación Sora para Android, como si fuera una aplicación completamente nueva, la desarrollamos en 18 días y luego, 10 días después, en total 28 días, la lanzamos al público.
key_sentence: The Sora Android app is a mind-blowing example of acceleration; we went to the public.

vocabulary.definition: The process of increasing speed or rate of progress in a particular context.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and technology, acceleration often refers to the rapid development and deployment of products or services, particularly in startup environments where time-to-market is critical.
vocabulary.nuance: While 'acceleration' typically conveys a positive connotation of growth and progress, it can also imply pressure or urgency that may lead to compromised quality if not managed properly.

text: I think there's constantly these levels of abstraction and they're actually already played out today. Today, coding agents, mostly it's prompt to patch. We're starting to see people doing spec-driven development or planned and driven development.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Lenny asks Alexander about the future of software development, specifically whether engineers will move to higher abstraction levels like spec-driven development rather than writing actual code. Alexander explains that these abstraction levels are already emerging, with current coding agents evolving from simple prompt-to-patch workflows to more sophisticated spec-driven and plan-driven development approaches.
text_ko: 지금은 계속해서 다양한 추상화 수준이 존재하는 것 같아요. 오늘날에는 주로 프롬프트를 패치하는 방식으로 코딩 에이전트들이 활용되고 있죠. 요즘에는 스펙 기반 개발(spec-driven development)이나 계획 기반 개발(planned and driven development)을 하는 사람들도 점점 늘어나고 있어요.
text_zh: 我认为在不断地存在这些抽象层次，而这些层次实际上已经在今天得到了体现。目前，编码代理主要是通过提示进行修补。我们开始看到人们在进行规范驱动开发（spec-driven development）或计划驱动开发（planned and driven development）。
text_es: Creo que constantemente existen estos niveles de abstracción que ya se están manifestando hoy en día. Actualmente, los agentes de codificación, en su mayoría, se basan en prompts para realizar parches. Estamos comenzando a ver a personas que practican el desarrollo basado en especificaciones (spec-driven development) o el desarrollo planificado y orientado (planned and driven development).
key_sentence: Levels of abstraction are already played out today in coding agents.

vocabulary.definition: Abstraction is the process of simplifying complex systems by focusing on the essential characteristics while ignoring irrelevant details.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and technology, abstraction is often used in software development to create models that represent complex systems, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and streamline processes.
vocabulary.nuance: While abstraction can enhance clarity and efficiency, over-abstraction may lead to a loss of important details, making it crucial to find the right balance.

vocabulary.definition: Spec-driven development is a software development approach that prioritizes the creation and adherence to detailed specifications throughout the development process.
vocabulary.businessContext: This methodology is commonly employed in tech startups to ensure that products meet predefined requirements, thereby reducing the risk of scope creep and misalignment with client expectations.
vocabulary.nuance: While spec-driven development can enhance project clarity and focus, it may also limit flexibility and adaptability in rapidly changing environments.

vocabulary.definition: Coding agents are automated systems or tools that assist in the software development process, often by generating code based on user prompts or specifications.
vocabulary.businessContext: In tech environments, coding agents are increasingly utilized to enhance productivity, reduce human error, and accelerate the development cycle, especially in tasks like debugging and code generation.
vocabulary.nuance: While coding agents can significantly improve efficiency, reliance on them may lead to a decline in developers' problem-solving skills if not balanced with traditional coding practices.

text: The current underappreciated limiting factor is literally human typing speed or human multitasking speed.
speaker: Alexander Embiricos
context: Lenny asks Alexander about his AGI timeline and how far we are from artificial general intelligence. Alexander shares his unique perspective that one of the biggest bottlenecks to achieving AGI-level productivity isn't the AI capabilities themselves, but rather human limitations in typing prompts and reviewing AI-generated work fast enough to keep up with AI's potential output.
text_ko: 현재 간과되고 있는 제한 요소는 사실상 사람의 타이핑 속도나 멀티태스킹 속도예요.
text_zh: 当前被低估的限制因素实际上是人类的打字速度或多任务处理速度。
text_es: El factor limitante que actualmente se subestima es, en realidad, la velocidad de tecleo humano o la velocidad de multitarea humana.
key_sentence: The underappreciated limiting factor is human typing speed.

vocabulary.definition: A limiting factor is a condition or variable that restricts or constrains a process or outcome, preventing it from achieving its full potential.
vocabulary.businessContext: In business and project management, identifying limiting factors is crucial for optimizing performance and resource allocation, as they can hinder productivity and efficiency.
vocabulary.nuance: The term often implies a critical barrier that, if addressed, could significantly improve results; it is typically used in strategic discussions.

vocabulary.definition: Multitasking refers to the ability to perform multiple tasks or activities simultaneously or to switch between tasks efficiently.
vocabulary.businessContext: In fast-paced business environments, multitasking is often seen as a valuable skill that can enhance productivity, though it may also lead to decreased focus and quality of work.
vocabulary.nuance: While multitasking is generally viewed positively, it can carry a negative connotation if it results in diminished performance or attention to detail.
